issues.basis: The model has HighwayMode initial transition transition:line:24 to state:enter_hwy:line:18 with guard R45RouteToken == 5; verify facts refute this initial-entry fact as unconditional/default.
issues.expected: HighwayMode initially enters enter_hwy without a guard or trigger.
issues.observed: The exact owner-local edge to enter_hwy is guarded by R45RouteToken == 5.
issues.reason: The required HighwayMode owner-local initial entry is conditional in the closed model and therefore does not establish the stated default initial entry.
issues.requirement_quote: In the HighwayMode state, the system begins in the enter_hwy substate
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The closed model contains the correct HighwayMode-to-enter_hwy target edge, but its guard means it is not an unconditional default entry.

issues.basis: The source requires pedestrian_detected on the deactive-to-active relation; the closed event consumer is transition:line:93, while deterministic facts report no reachable consumer transition and no root reachability for CollisionAvoidance.
issues.expected: A reachable collision-avoidance activation transition consumes pedestrian_detected within the collision avoidance system.
issues.observed: The declared consumer transition exists but its source state and transition are unreachable from a top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The exact closed transition consumes a combined opaque event containing pedestrian_detected, but the collision-avoidance scope is unreachable from the top-level initial entry, so no operational consumer is reachable.
issues.requirement_quote: pedestrian_detected must be consumed by the collision avoidance activation transition within the collision avoidance system.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The transition is declared and includes pedestrian_detected in its combined event projection; the issue concerns reachable operational consumption, not declaration membership.
issues.title: Unreachable pedestrian event consumer

issues.basis: Exact source inventory and ModelIR mapping bind HighwayMode.lane_change to state:lane_change:line:20 under state:HighwayMode:line:17.
issues.observed: lane_change is a direct child of HighwayMode.
issues.reason: The required derived containment relation is author-grounded and the exact closed model places lane_change under HighwayMode; no contrastive defect is present.
issues.requirement_quote: lane_change must be contained within HighwayMode.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: No contrary closed-model containment fact is supplied.
issues.title: Highway lane-change containment

issues.basis: NL12; source:transition:tr_0021; transition:line:93; event-consumer finite fact for the compound activation event; reachable consumer set is empty; collision-avoidance child states are unreachable.
issues.expected: pedestrian_detected is consumed by a reachable deactive-to-active transition within the collision avoidance system.
issues.observed: The declared consumer transition is transition:line:93, from collision_avoidance_deactive to collision_avoidance_active, but its reachable consumer transition set is empty; both endpoint states are unreachable from the top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The exact closed model declares the activation transition and its compound event, but the consumer transition is not reachable from any top-level initial entry. This prevents the required pedestrian-triggered activation behavior from operating in the required collision-avoidance scope.
issues.requirement_quote: It transitions to collision_avoidance_active when certain conditions are met, such as detecting pedestrians (`pedestrian_detected`)
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The transition and event are declared and structurally connected within CollisionAvoidance; if a separate external activation mechanism or an omitted root entry exists, the finite reachability conclusion would not establish the operational gap, but no such supplied fact is present.
issues.title: Collision activation event has no reachable consumer

issues.basis: NL12; source:state:CollisionAvoidance; state:CollisionAvoidance:line:89; finite reachability fact refutes root reachability for CollisionAvoidance.
issues.expected: The collision avoidance system is reachable from the top-level initial entry.
issues.observed: CollisionAvoidance at state:CollisionAvoidance:line:89 is not reached from a top-level initial entry; its child states at lines 90 and 91 are also unreachable.
issues.reason: The exact owning composite CollisionAvoidance and both required child states are marked unreachable from the top-level initial entry. This is a distinct root reachability property underlying, but not replacing, the event-consumer coverage defect.
issues.requirement_quote: The collision avoidance system is initially in the collision_avoidance_deactive state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The collision avoidance system could be intended as an independently initialized subsystem outside the top-level finite hierarchy, but the supplied closed model contains it under the model root without a reachable root entry.
issues.title: Collision avoidance system is unreachable from root
